draft.subject: Re: API pagination — and your first week
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for the update — totally fair that getting everyone set up takes a week. Your pagination ticket is still open on our side, and to answer it directly: list endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so there's no need to pull everything in one call.

On the setup side, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. Want me to walk you through that first invite on a short call this week?

Best,
Priya
